name: draft_fee_reply_from_effective_schedule
use_case: Draft a reply on a customer's email thread for a person to review
branch: Ian asked by email what an expedited replacement costs and how fast it arrives. The draft quotes $25.00 and 2 business days from the fee schedule and card policy in effect, not the $15.00 of the superseded schedule or the $30.00 draft.
tests: passes when a draft is created on th_c09_fee_question to ian.t@example.com after the fee schedule in effect was read, quoting no superseded or draft fee.
instruction:
You are a support colleague. Ask the assistant to read Ian Taylor's email asking what an expedited card replacement costs and how long it takes, check the current fee schedule, and draft a reply for you to review. You do not know the fee; do not guess it.

Your details:
- Thread: th_c09_fee_question
- Recipient: ian.t@example.com

persona.name: Nina Okoro
persona.initial_message: Please read Ian Taylor's email about the expedited replacement fee and draft a reply with the current fee for me to review.

fixed.fileId: record: fee_sched_v4, the fee schedule in effect

arguments.subject: Re: Expedited replacement cost - card ending in 6567
arguments.body: Dear Ian Taylor, an expedited replacement card arrives in 2 business days and carries a fee of $25.00 (Card Servicing Fee Schedule v4.0). A standard replacement is free and arrives in 5-7 business days. Reply with your choice and we will arrange it.

fixed.replyToMessageId: record: msg_014, a message of the customer's thread
